title: Fix SRD audit count mismatch and minor sourceText artifact
description:
Problem:
The 2026-06-29 audit bundle has minor audit cleanliness issues.

Findings:
- Authoritative pack/report count is 1,812 records, including feature:184 and hazard:25.
- command-output/verify-dnd5e-srd-pack.txt printed a stale/misleading line with 183 features, 0 hazards, and 8 traps.
- class:rogue has clean fixed equipment text, but sourceText includes a likely PDF/list-marker artifact: '(a) Leather armor, two daggers, and thieves' tools'.

Implement:
- Make verify/importer human-readable counts align with final record kinds and authoritative reports.
- Remove or normalize the rogue starting-equipment sourceText artifact if it is produced by importer extraction rather than intentionally preserved source text.
- Add regression coverage so count summaries do not drift from pack summaries.

Acceptance criteria:
- verify:dnd5e-srd-pack output agrees with pack record counts by kind.
- No stale '0 hazards, 8 traps' style count remains if hazards are now the canonical kind.
- Rogue starting equipment sourceText is either clean or explicitly justified by a test.
- Existing tests and pack verification pass.
close_reason: Completed together in PR: traps now expose category trap with schema/tests/generated pack updates; verifier/importer summaries report final record-kind and hazard-category counts; rogue fixed equipment sourceText normalized; audit bundle emits gameplay-readiness report.
